adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, bookingCalendarReference was changed to an array via .filter(...) and then iterated (for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)). Inside that loop, the recurring-cancellation branch still iterates updatedBookings and does `const bookingRef = updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"));`, which will only pick the first calendar reference per remaining booking and ignore any additional _calendar references (orphaning other hosts’ calendar events). Additionally, because the entire recurring deletion logic is nested inside the outer `for (const reference ...)` loop, the delete-all-remaining-bookings work (the Promise.all over all calendar credentials and updatedBookings) will re-run once per calendar reference, causing duplicate delete calls for the same first-found reference events.
